confidenceCalibration.claim: High confidence and accuracy demonstrated in Reading & Writing synthesis, central ideas, text structure, and quantitative evidence.
Overconfidence in fast mental arithmetic during high-difficulty Math items leads to unforced execution errors.

errorTaxonomy.label: Sign & Constant Omission in Linear/Nonlinear Systems
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Multiplying equations by negative multipliers without carrying negative signs to constants or omitting the discriminant b^2 - 4ac setup under rapid pace.

errorTaxonomy.label: Speed-Induced Computational Error
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Skipping written scratchpad steps in multi-step algebraic manipulation or slope calculation in under 35s.

errorTaxonomy.label: Dangling Modifier Misattribution
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Matching an introductory participial phrase to a non-human entity (e.g. 'the research study' or 'the database') instead of the human subject performing the action.

errorTaxonomy.label: Punctuation Boundary Over-Extension
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Placing an em-dash immediately before a coordinating conjunction ('but') when connecting independent clauses.

errorTaxonomy.label: Proportional Shift vs Percentage Reduction Confusion
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Selecting the remaining height/volume fraction (64%) instead of subtracting from 100% to calculate the required percentage decrease (36%).

errorTaxonomy.label: Triangulation & Geometric Ratio Misstep
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Misidentifying opposite vs adjacent legs in right triangles or rushing vertex angle calculations in isosceles triangles.

executiveSummary: This evidence-bound learning report analyzes 98 completed SAT answer events from this set (period the recorded date to the recorded date). Overall performance stands at 86.7% accuracy (85/98 correct), with an average elapsed time of 30 seconds per item. Reading & Writing achieved 92.6% accuracy (50/54 correct, 27s/item), showcasing strong mastery of Rhetorical Synthesis, Central Ideas, Text Structure/Purpose, and Evidence Analysis, with minor errors limited to Level 5 Words in Context and Standard English modifier/punctuation boundaries. Math achieved 79.5% accuracy (35/44 correct, 33s/item), demonstrating robust conceptual understanding of Equivalent Expressions and Functions, but suffering from speed-induced execution errors on Level 4/5 Systems of Equations, Linear Inequalities, and Geometry/Trig. The current score project is 1420 (RW 750, Math 670) against a 1600 target, requiring a pace-corrected, paper-first approach to close the 180-point gap.

learnerModel.summary: Learner demonstrates exceptional strength in RW synthesis, central ideas, and structural analysis (92.6% accuracy), but shows score leakage in Math (79.5% accuracy) driven by rushed execution (<35s/item) on Level 4/5 Systems of Equations, Linear Inequalities, and Geometry.

limitations: Performance metrics are bound to 98 completed answer events within a single session window.
High speed in Math (33s average) suggests reliance on mental calculation without mandatory scratchpad verification.
Reading & Writing Level 5 questions represent a smaller subset (12 items), requiring expanded evaluation across varied text genres.

misconceptionPatterns.claim: Dangling Modifier Misattribution: Attributing introductory participial actions to noun phrases representing tools or databases rather than human agents.
Discriminant Calculation Error in Quadratic Systems: Setting discriminant equal to zero on individual quadratic equations rather than on the combined system equation.
Percentage Remaining vs Percentage Decrease Confusion: Selecting the ratio of final-to-initial volume (64%) rather than subtracting from 100% to find the percentage reduction (36%).
Excessive Speed Truncation: Rushing through multi-step arithmetic/algebraic manipulation in under 35s leading to sign inversion or misreading of inequality bounds.
